headlines.summary: Three stocks you know are trading lower this year. One should bounce back soon.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Unveils New Partnership, Is It Still Below Fair Value?
headlines.summary: Netflix (NFLX) is back in the spotlight after unveiling “The Gentlemen’s Serve,” a multi-country partnership with Stella Artois tied to the second season of Guy Ritchie’s series The Gentlemen. Netflix’s latest brand tie up lands as the stock trades at US$80.81, with a 30 day share price return of 12.69% but a year to date share price decline of 11.19%, while the 1 year total shareholder return is down 33.44% despite an 80.11% gain over three years.

headlines.title: FuboTV Rallies 7%, Disney Ticks Up: Is the Hulu Live TV Deal Finally Getting Credit?
headlines.summary: FuboTV is surging midday with no earnings release, no filing, and no corporate announcement to explain it. Something is shifting in how the market values the combined live TV bundle, and it shows up very differently across three tickers.

headlines.title: IMAX CFO Natasha Fernandes Sells $1.1 Million in Stock -- Should Investors Cash-in After the Stock Surged 78%?
headlines.summary: Fernandes retains 35,596 common shares and 32,764 restricted units despite the disposition, maintaining significant equity exposure as IMAX stock surges 78% over the past year.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
